Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka surrender rather meekly yet again in the first innings. The conditions seemed treacherous while they batted and Kuldeep Yadav tricked their batsmen into submission. None of their batsmen displayed any resilience that one associates with Test cricket. Chandimal kept the Indian bowlers at bay for a while, but he was invariably just delaying the inevitable. Apart from him, only Dickwella got some kind of start yet he threw it away at a time when the need of the hour was to grind it out. Join us in a while as we will see the Lankan openers striding out for the second time today.

OUT! That's the final nail in the coffin! Short delivery on middle and leg, spinning down. Sandakan rocks back and looks to pull it through square leg but only manages to get a thick inside edge onto his thigh pad. The ball spoons behind and goes to the left side of Dhawan at leg gully who pouches it safely. A brilliant bowling display from India. SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 135!
Slow through the air, Sandakan comes down the track and looks to slog it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up around off, Sandakan lunges forward in defense.
Flatter one, defended off the back foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Lahiru Kumara is the last man in.

OUT! Kuldeep is having a great outing, gets a 4-fer to his name! Bowls this one slower through the air around off and gets it to turn in appreciably. Fernando looks to defend it tentatively but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Then, the ball deflects back to crash into the stumps. The misery continues for the hosts.
On middle and leg, defended watchfully.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman
Floated outside off, spinning in. Vishwa looks to defend it but is beaten on the inside.
The change of angle almost did the trick! Slips in a googly on off, Fernando looks to defend it but gets an outside edge that falls short of Rahane at first slip.
Variation from Ashwin. Leg spinner outside off, Sandakan fails to dig it out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
FOUR! Good positive cricket from Sandakan! Slow through the air, Sandakan uses his feet and chips it over mid off. The fielder there hares after it but only comes second best.
Sandakan strides forward and defends this carrom ball.
Spinning sharply down the leg side, Lakshan looks to play it across but misses.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up delivery, Sandakan comes down the track and lifts it over the leaping Pandya at mid on to earn a boundary.
Worked with the spin to deep square leg for a run.
Flighted delivery, defended off the back foot.
The wrong 'un this time. Sandakan stays back to keep it out.
Floated delivery, eased to mid off.
Tossed up delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on middle, spinning down. Fernando looks to defend it but is hit on the pads. An appeal follows but that was going down leg.
Quicker one on leg stump, clipped to the leg side for a run.
Loopy delivery, Sandakan lunges forward in defense.
Shorter outside off, generates extra bounce on that. Sandakan goes for the cut but misses.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, defended off the front foot.
During the drinks break, the Indian side was in a huddle. The discussion would have been to whether enforce the follow-on or not.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery outside off, Vishwa goes at it with hard hands but ends up jamming it down the track.
Stays back to this one and keeps it out.
Turns in sharply from outside off, Fernando prods forward to defend it but gets it off the inner half towards short leg.
Vishwa Fernando strides out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Another one bites the dust! Full delivery around middle, skids on through the surface. Pushpakumara misreads the length, comes a couple of steps down the track and ends up yorking himself. Misses it altogether to get the furniture behind him shattered. Sri Lanka in complete disarray! Kuldeep gets his third wicket.
Tossed up outside off, driven to wide mid off.
Loopy ball around off, Sandakan gets it off the inside half to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball outside off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up ball on middle, played to short leg.
Lakshan Sandakan comes out to bat.
Time for Drinks. India are all over Sri Lanka. The home side are failing to find a solution to the turn and grip on this surface and are falling like a pack of cards.

OUT! Soft dismissal in the end for the Lankan skipper! This wicket might hasten their fall. Tossed up delivery around off and middle, Chandimal looks to flick it. But he does so straight to leg gully, where Rahul doesn't falter. He was looking decent out there as he was approaching a 50. Ashwin gets a wicket, Sri Lanka trail by 362.
This floated ball is bunted on to the ground.
Tossed up ball around off and middle, defended off the front foot.
Flighted ball around off and middle, it strikes him high on his pads as Malinda misses the ball. The Indians appeal to no avail.
This loopy ball is blocked by getting right behind the line of the ball.
FOUR! Tossed up ball around middle, swept powerfully through square leg by Pushpakumara for a boundary. There was no fielder in the deep there.
This flighted delivery is flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Dinesh shows the full face of the bat as he blocks it.
Loopy ball around middle, Chandimal defends showing the full face of the bat.
Floated around middle, flicked away to the leg side for a run.
Again a flighted ball is blocked from the crease.
This one's the carrom ball, that strikes him low on the pads.
Fired in around off, blocked off the front foot.
Loopy ball around off and middle, defended.
Flighted ball outside off and turning in sharply as Dinesh looks to flick but misses. The Indian players appeal for LBW which is turned down.
Another tossed up ball, Malinda gets an inside edge on to his pads as he defends.
Pushpakumara looks to drive this loopy ball but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball outside off, the ball goes past the edge as Malinda comes forward to defend.
Loopy ball around off and middle, Chandimal gets a leading edge towards covers for a run.
Tossed up full ball outside off, Chandimal bottom edges it as it rolls to the keeper.
This flighted ball is well defended by Chandimal.
Fired in around leg, Pushpakumara takes a hit on his pads as he misses the shot. The fielding side puts up a shout for LBW, turned down.
Tossed up delivery bunted down.
Quicker ball around off, played from the crease.
This flighted ball around off and middle, is blocked on to the ground.
FOUR! Aaah! Cheeky and effective. Tossed up off spinner outside off and turning in, Pushpakumara watches it closely and plays it ever so late to guide to the third man fence for a boundary.
Slow turning ball down the leg side, Malinda looks to hit that and misses.
Slow loopy ball on leg, Chandimal looks to sweep but misses, and wears the ball full on his pad.
The field is coming up to save the single.
Loopy ball on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Deep square leg comes in to invite the sweep shot.
Flatter ball is flicked to mid-wicket.
Round the wicket, Kuldeep bowls a googly. The ball takes the outside edge of the poking bat and rolls through point for a single.
This leg spinning ball is flicked away on the leg side for a run.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Chandimal sweeps but misses. The ball passed agonizingly close to the leg stump.
This time Dinesh sweeps the loopy ball for a single.
Flighted ball around off and middle, Chandimal keeps it out.
Floated around middle, blocked.

NOT OUT! India lose both their reviews! That's tossed up around off and turning into Chandimal, who tries to sweep and misses. The ball passes his left arm and settles in to Saha's gloves which brings up an appeal from the Indians. On seeing that denied, the Indians review. The Snicko doesn't return any spike as the ball passes the glove. So the on-field call stays.
Virat Kohli opts to take a review for a caught behind appeal against Chandimal. Seems like there was daylight between between bat and ball.
Tossed up ball around off, Chandimal defends showing the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball around off, Chandimal pushed it to mid-wicket.
This one is a turning ball that is tucked to short fine leg. Chandimal denies him the run there.
This is the wrong 'un from round the wicket which is too much for the no. 8. It passes the prodding edge of the bat.
No cover in place now. Point comes in. Kuldeep will encourage him to drive and hence, induce a false stroke.
Round the wicket, tossed up outside off, left alone.
He played for the turn as the ball went straight past the outside edge of his bat.
Full toss outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Flighted ball around middle, blocked off the front foot.
He safely negotiated that flighted ball by blocking it.
This tossed up delivery is presented the full face of the bat. The ball falls just short of short leg after taking the inside edge of the bat.
Another front foot defense to a tossed up ball around off and middle. The bowler thought it was pad first and put in an appeal to see it turned down.
This is floated around middle, blocked off the front foot.
Solid front foot defense by Malinda to that loopy ball.
Loopy ball around off, blocked from the crease.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
Flatter and quicker outside off, slapped through wide mid off, where Ashwin chases down. The batsmen get a brace.
Another floated ball, played to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around middle, nudged to short leg.
Tossed up around off, placed towards backward point for a run.
Loopy ball on off, blocked.
Malinda Pushpakumara walks in at the fall of the 6th wicket.

OUT! There are days when good balls go for runs and on some, even bad balls fetch you wickets! A rank half-tracker on middle, Perera either could have hit it anywhere out of the park or nudged somewhere round the corner for some runs. Instead he decides to go aerially and ends up picking out the lone man, Hardik Pandya, at deep mid-wicket to perfection. The hosts are just disintegrating quickly here.
Bowled on a length around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a brace.
Length ball around off, driven to mid off.

FOUR BYES! Dangerous even for the keeper standing far from the stumps. This length ball outside off is left alone. The ball bounces just in front of Saha and bounces a tad more to hit his shoulders and run away to the fence. On such tracks, the keeper should wear his helmet even when standing far it seems.
This good length ball is shouldered arms to, as it swings in after the batsman and goes in to Saha's gloves.
Shami steams in and spears it around off, Chandimal blocks it showing the full face of the bat.

Umesh Yadav has pulled up in his delivery stride. He is walking across gingerly. He is in a lot of discomfort and is now heading back to the dressing room. A while back, he landed awkwardly on the ground while trying to stop a boundary. Hope it is nothing serious. Meanwhile, Shami comes to complete the over in his place.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal point his bat skywards as he leaves it alone.
Umesh Yadav is back on. 3-0-23-0 read his figures as of now.
Flatter ball, played to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball around middle, defended off the front foot on to the ground.
Straighter ball outside off, Perera plays for the non-existent turn and misses.
Dilruwan Perera walks in next.

OUT! Yes, this was coming once you couldn't pick the spinner yet were intent on attacking him. That was a tossed up wrong 'un around middle, inviting Dickwella to go for a big shot. He does so and ends up missing the ball completely. Saha behind didn't miss the stumping chance and that ends Niroshan's expressive innings.
Tossed up ball around leg, Dickwella paddles it fine for a brace. That bring up Sri Lanka's 100.
Loopy ball around off and middle, flicked away to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Short and wide ball, Chandimal slaps it through cover-point as the ball rushes towards the fence. Umesh runs there from deep point but seems like he fails to keep the ball in the field of play despite multiple attempts to do so. The umpire checks upstairs for the boundary and it is one.
Back of a length ball around off, pushed through covers for a run. As Dickwella was running Pandya said some words to him, which infuriated the Lankan keeper.

FOUR! Dashing Dickwella is on a roll! Length ball around off and middle, he takes the aerial route as he goes over mid on. The ball goes to the fence for a boundary. Didn't really get it off the meat of the bat though.
Hardik bowls it on a length outside off, played through point for a run.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot.
50-run partnership between Chandimal and Dickwella.
Length ball on his pads, flicked away in front of square for a double.
Flatter ball around off, he punches it to the off side.
Floated gently around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! And this one's even better. Another flighted ball on off, Chandimal smashes it to the right of mid off for the third boundary of the over. He's taking the attack to the spinner here.
Loopy ball around middle, played to the left of short leg for no run.
FOUR! Glorious shot that! Tossed up ball around off, Chandimal gets to the pitch and creams it wide of mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! The first real bad ball from the tweaker. Short and wide of off, Chandimal just crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length ball around off, Dickwella jumps and pushes it to point.
Fuller ball around off, Chandimal gets a single to deep point off the outer half of his bat, as he tries to push it on the off side.
A tad fuller around off, the batsman defends it off his front foot towards the cover region.
Length ball outside off, left alone by the Lankan skipper.
Bowled on a length around middle and leg, tucked away through square leg for a brace.
Slower length ball around middle and leg, Dickwella knocks it with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a quick run.
A bit more air on that delivery as DC strides forward and defends.
A straighter ball which the skipper is struggling to pick. He somehow gets bat on to that and blocks.
A googly around middle and leg, Dinesh gets bat to it at the last moment to block it.
Floated around middle and leg, Dickwella makes room and drives it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up ball around off, Dickwella gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket to collect a boundary.
Loopy ball around off, bunted down from the crease.
Full and driving length ball outside off, Dinesh goes for the shot and misses. There was a hint of swing there.

That's a back of a length ball outside off, Chandimal slaps it through covers. The ball rolls towards the boundary. The outfield is slow and hence, the sweeper cover has ample time to run to his right and cut it off. Keeps the batsmen down to two.
Length ball outside off, left alone. The ball swung in after passing the batsman.
This is straight and quick around off, pushed to the cover region.
Length ball around off, defended off the front foot by Chandimal.
Length ball around off, punched through covers for a run.
Hardik Pandya to bowl from the other end.
Floated googly around middle and leg, again Chandimal gets the edge of the bat as the ball rolls to the off side.
Tossed up wrong 'un around middle, Chandimal completely missed the line of the ball as he looked to whip in to the on side.
Loopy ball around leg, pushed back to the bowler.
This one turns away sharply as Dickwella cuts it to the left of point for a run.
Loopy ball played aerially towards mid-wicket.
Starts of with a googly around middle, Dickwella made room to cut, but was cramped for room and ended up dabbing it to point.
We are back for the evening session. 41 overs are left today. Dinesh Chandimal and Niroshan Dickwella to continue their innings. Kuldeep Yadav to continue his spell. Here we go...
... Day Two, Session Three ...

India are on top and continue to dominate. After posting a huge total on the board, their bowlers were right on the money from the beginning. Especially Shami, who bowled a fiery spell and made life difficult for the opposition. He sent both the openers packing in quick time. After that, the combined brilliance of Ashwin and Kuldeep resulted in Mendis' downfall. Hardik Pandya continued to have a cracking day, trapping Mathews off guard. Sri Lanka are caught in shallow waters and they will need the pair of Chandimal and Dickwella to stitch a substantial stand. Join us in a while for the evening session.
Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, he again gets a run on the leg side off the inside half of his bat. THAT'S TEA, DAY 2!
This slower ball in line of the stumps is blocked from the crease as the ball stayed a touch low.
Floated around off, Chandimal pushes it towards covers with soft hands for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, Dickwella gets it off the inside of his bat to the leg side as he looks to play it to the off side. They take a run.

FOUR! The sweep gets him runs again. Tossed up ball around off and middle, Dickwella sweeps it powerfully in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. He's already playing the attacking brand of cricket that he's known for.
Loopy ball around off, Dickwella comes down and plays to mid off.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack.
Flatter ball around off, ND steps down and places it to the off side for a run.
Loopy ball pushed to mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! This time Chandimal nails the sweep. Flighted ball around leg, he gets down and sweeps through fine leg for a boundary.
Floated up delivery around leg, Chandimal looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. The Indians appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Pitching outside the leg stump, mostly.
This time the tossed up delivery turns a tad, played to short leg.
Tossed up ball around off that went straight on, placed towards the off side for no run.
Kuldeep Yadav, the chinaman bowler is brought in to bowl.
This length ball is defended off the back foot.
Another ball down the leg side goes to the keeper as he misses the flick.
Length ball around off, played to point.
Fuller ball around leg, Dickwella wears it on his pads as he misses his flick. The Indians appeal, but the umpire stays unmoved. Such deliveries generally pitch outside the leg stump line.
Bouncer on middle and off, Dickwella sways back and lets it go to the keeper.
Length ball down the leg side, Niroshan tries a flick and misses.
Length ball around off, driven to mid off.
Another good shot in this match doesn't get the runs that it deserves. Full ball outside off, driven through covers by Niroshan. The batsmen run three as Ashwin chases it down from mid off.
Fuller ball around off, driven towards wide mid off for a single.
Straight ball outside off left alone.
Bowled around off, played to point.

Back of a length ball outside off, Dinesh plays it to the left of point. There is a slight hesitation yet again in the running between the wickets and they take a run as Rahul has a shy at the striker's end and misses. The overthrow results in another run.
On a length around leg stump, angling in. Dickwella looks to clip it away but gets hit on the pads. Another appeal for an LBW but this one has probably pitched outside leg. End of an eventful over.
FOUR! Crisp! Fullish delivery outside off, angling away. Dickwella leans into and strokes it through covers for a glorious boundary. He is off the mark in style.
Swinging into Dickwella. He defends it off the front foot.
Niroshan Dickwella is the new man in.

OUT! The wicket-to-wicket line has done the trick for Hardik Pandya! He is having a terrific day. Smart bowling brings in another dismissal. Length delivery on middle and leg, stays low. Mathews hangs back to keep it out but gets pinged low on the front pad. A confident appeal follows and up goes the umpire's finger. The former captain doesn't review it and keeps walking back to the dressing room. It looked quite plumb. Sri Lanka are in dire straits now.
Length delivery in line of the stumps, stays a bit low. Angelo keeps it out.
Length delivery on off, Mathews stays back and blocks it.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal is squared up and gets beaten.
Angelo Mathews strides out to bat. Sri Lanka are in a real spot of bother.

OUT! Sri Lanka are in disarray here in Pallekele! A run out it is that leads to Mendis' downfall. Fuller ball around off and middle, flicked wide of mid on. Mendis runs down in search of a run, but is sent back as Ashwin at mid on runs to his right and makes a diving stop. He has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. It would have been curtains for Kusal if he had hit. But Kuldeep at covers, backs up that throw and immediately hits the stumps down at the bowler's end, while Shami is seen reacting to the first throw. The third umpire is called for and on replays, the batsman is found short.
The third umpire is referred to for a run out appeal against Mendis. Looks out to the naked eye.
Length around off, played to the off side off the back foot.
FOUR! Shami is searching for the swing and hence bowls it full outside off. Chandimal gets to the pitch and drives it beautifully through mid off for a boundary to get going.
Speared in straighter around off, pushed to point defensively.
Length ball around middle, played through square leg off the back foot for a run.
This straight ball in line of the stumps is played from the crease.
Length ball outside off, played in the gap between cover and point for a quick run.
Length around middle, pushed to mid-wicket.
This one's bowled outside off, which is left alone.
A man at short mid-wicket in place now.
FOUR! Mendis on a four-hitting spree, his fourth. Length ball around off and middle, Kusal whips it through square leg for another boundary on the leg side.
Length ball around off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Yes, Hardik Pandya will bowl now.
Length ball around off, bunted on to the ground. Maiden from Shami.
This time a full outswinger outside off, Chandimal times it sweetly to the right of Pandya at covers. He stretches out his right hand to stop it.
Full inswinging delivery around off, pushed towards mid off for no run.
That's too wide of off for Chandimal to make any contact.
Fuller ball outside off, draws the batsman into the shot. The ball takes the outside edge and lands agonizingly short of the diving third slip fielder.
Hardik Pandya is seen warming up. Some signs?
Length ball outside off, Dinesh has nothing to do with that.
FOUR! Mendis is too good to miss out on opportunities like that. That was full on middle and leg, clipped away over square leg for a boundary.
Bouncer around off, ducked under by Mendis.
Short ball around off, played off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Kusal pokes and gets beaten.
Another length ball bunted on to the ground.
Length ball around off, blocked off the front foot.

NOT OUT! It's all happening! Length ball outside off angling into Chandimal, he strides to defend and misses the ball to get hit on his pad. The Indians appeal, only to see a denial. Virat goes for the review. The Ball Tracker shows that it would have clipped the top of the stumps and hence, the umpire's call comes into play. So Chandimal stays on.
India have reviewed an LBW call against Chandimal. Looks not out to the naked eye.
Length ball around off, defended from the crease.
Length ball outside off, he inside edges it on to his pads.
WIDE! Bouncer well outside off, left alone. The umpire signals an overhead wide.
Dinesh Chandimal, the skipper of the side in trouble, walks out next.

OUT! The previous match centurion departs cheaply this time. A beaut of a length ball outside off, coming in to Karunaratne and leaves him ever so slightly as he plays at the original line. The ball takes the edge of the bat and goes low to Saha, who bends his left knee to pouch it smartly. Excellent bowling, even better catching. The umpire went upstairs to check if the catch was clean for which the third umpire returned an affirmation.
Length ball outside off, he inside edges it on to his pads.
Length ball on off, played from the crease.
Back of a length ball around off, coming in. Mendis jumps and gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad.

FOUR! Boundary ball, dealt with. Length ball on middle and leg, clipped away through mid-wicket by Mendis for another boundary. Umesh just letting the batsmen get off the pressure that Shami is creating.

Good length ball around off and middle and coming into him, Mendis looks to flick but wears it on his pads. The Indians appeal for an LBW to be turned down by the umpire. Replays showed that it would have gone down.
FOUR! Length ball angling into him, Kusal Mendis uses the pace of the ball and guides it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Length ball on his pads, he misses his flick and they steal a leg bye.

What's happening, Sri Lanka? Back of a length ball around off, pushed to point. Mendis wanted a run and was halfway down the pitch when he was sent back. The fielder had a shy at the bowler's end and missed. If he'd hit, Mendis would have been back in the dressing room now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Third slip in place now.
Another peach of a delivery! Short delivery around off, shoots through after pitching. Mendis looks to evade it and does so awkwardly.
Welcomes Mendis to the crease with a snorter! Shami hits the deck hard around off, Mendis hangs his bat in the air like a periscope but the ball whizzes past him.
Kusal Mendis comes in at the fall of the early wicket.

OUT! Sri Lanka waste a review! Fuller in length outside off, swings in a touch. Tharanga pushes at it with minimal foot movement and gets a faint nick. Saha dives to his right and takes a good low catch. The Indians go up in an appeal in unison and the umpire obliges. Upul walks across to Karunaratne and the latter tells him to go for the DRS. The Ultra Edge confirms the nick. Tharanga is disappointed and has to walk back.
Upul Tharanga opts to take a review after Karunaratne suggests him to do so. It is against a caught behind decision. Seems like there was a clear nick.
Sloppy work! Angling in sharply into Karunaratne. He gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket where Kuldeep is lazy and makes a mess of it. Concedes a single.
Back of a length well outside off, left alone.
Well bowled! Length delivery around off, swings in a touch. Tharanga keeps his bat and pad close together to block it.
FIVE WIDES! Fuller length delivery outside off, stays low and swings away late. Saha dives to his left but fails to stop it from reaching the third man fence. Bonus runs for Sri Lanka.
A straightish extra cover in place now.
FOUR! Elegant! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Tharanga strokes it through extra cover and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Fullish on this ocassion outside off, inviting Dimuth to play a drive. He pushes at it but gets it off the inner half to mid off. The batsmen steal a run.
Sri Lanka's highest opening stand against India in the last ten Tests is just 22. That's something that the hosts would look to improve on.
Similar length delivery well outside off, holding its line. Karunaratne  doesn't fiddle with it.
Good length delivery angling across Upul. He punches it firmly through extra cover for a single. Gets off the mark with that.
Length delivery outside off, a bit of nip in the air. Tharanga points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Umesh Yadav to share the new ball.
Fuller ball starting from outside off, swung in a great deal as it passed the stumps. Saha had to dive to collect it.
Short ball on his body, Karunaratne jumps and plays it through square leg for a brace to get off the mark.
That's a harmless ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, nipping into Karunaratne. He gets an inside edge on to his pads as he tries to block it a bit away from the body.
Length ball on off, played from within the crease.
Starts off with a bouncer around off. The ball swings away to the leg side as Dimuth ducks under that. Saha collects it well.
